population: All unique (skeleton_id, group_id, candidate_index) proposals with whole_route_checks.status=PASS, from all 20 completed pools; before episode-combination expansion, including accepted groups within rejected skeletons. Member counts are candidate-member records, not distinct physical agent IDs. No proposal regenerated and no simulation executed.

pre_entry_clearance_audit.scope: Selected eligible episode candidate only; recompute exact primitive footprint clearance for every segment before formal entry alignment segment, using stored waypoints/references and registered scene. All accepted pool records additionally have no stored pre_entry_warning_clearance issue; numerical minima for unselected plans are not stored and not inferred.

retreat_counting_scope: One selected eligible episode plan per passing skeleton. Count only geometry_provenance.retreat_by_agent records; transit has no F3 record and intrusion has no retreat, neither is inferred as zero degrees.

zero_feasible_groups.counting_method: Top-level counts count proposals once; local_shape_reason_counts count one outcome per local draw; nested *_occurrences count every saved issue/reason occurrence and are not proposal counts. Closest ranking is (stage rank, whole-route issue count, candidate index); equal first two fields means candidate #0 wins only by index, not by geometric closeness.
